prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night just after rain on a 1930s city street: wet cobbles, an iron street lamp overhead, a shop window full of loaves glowing warm behind, under a plain blank sign, an ultramarine sky with a small red moon. Close on two back pockets side by side at hip height on a wet night street: on the left, the back pocket of faded blue denim overalls, on the right, the pocket of a grey factory smock. Out of each pokes a thin brown paper pay envelope with no writing on it, exactly the same, thin and creased. The fringed end of a red scarf hangs beside the left pocket, the end of a blue scarf beside the right. Behind, out of focus, the street lamp, the warm shop window of loaves and the wet cobbles. Most of the frame in shadow; the brightest values are the two pale envelopes in the lamplight. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
